name: Kiriya Takuma
source:
He is a university student and moved into the apartment building where Mamoru and Kaede live.
Takuma is also an old friend of Kaede and have always admired her as an older sister.
Their reunion reignites his crush. He’s called "Tak-kun" by Kaede.
